svg.title: Azores Current: two reported seasonal model-core spans
svg.desc: About 240 km in WOA09 spring (April to June), about 400 km in autumn (October to December), on a regional inverse-model section at 19.5 W using a 2 cm/s velocity criterion. Width uncertainty, winter/summer values and annual physical ranges remain unknown. Points are independent source summaries and are not interpolated.

g.text: Azores Current / reported seasonal model core
19.5 W regional section / velocities greater than 2 cm/s
WOA09 seasons: April-June and October-December. Native hydrographic grid: 1 degree.
No width error supplied. Winter/summer widths, full-current dimensions and annual ranges unknown.
Mixed historical climatological support; no monthly interpolation or mapped width footprint.
Source: Carracedo et al. (2014), Progress in Oceanography 122, p.122 / doi:10.1016/j.pocean.2013.12.005.
Season definitions: NOAA World Ocean Atlas 2009, Volume 1, p.1. OSW comparison; scientific admission pending.
